notes: Bundles Asciidoctor.js 3.0.4 and highlight.js 11.12.0 with matching stylesheets. The minified Asciidoctor browser bundle has a CommonJS export adapter appended for OpenAF. Version 4 uses a different ESM API and is not a drop-in replacement. replyAsciidoc disables remote webfonts and serves its JavaScript and CSS locally. For direct standalone conversion use attributes: { webfonts: false } to suppress Google Fonts links.
transforms: Append module.exports = module$build$asciidoctor_browser.default; to the upstream minified browser bundle.
